command:
set -eu
echo QD_STRINGS_START
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
if command -v strings >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 for p in /factory_peq/tcon_data/QD/*.bin; do
  test -f "$p"
  test ! -L "$p"
  test "$(wc -c < "$p")" = 5242880
  echo "FILE=$p"
  strings -a -t x "$p" | awk 'index($0,"F77ABU2D20") || index($0,"RHEA_M_TCON_FW") || index($0,"RT Protect") || index($0,"RTOS Ver") || index($0,"TconFw") {n++; if(n<=20) print substr($0,1,256)} END {print "MARKER_MATCHES",n+0}'
 done
else
 echo STRINGS_TOOL_ABSENT
fi
echo QD_STRINGS_END
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
mode: bounded literal scan of existing data assets only
